ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 98:2 ratio of low-intensity (dark grey/black) to high-intensity (white/light) pixels; high-intensity pixels are isolated to distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant uniform dark-grey contiguous blob across both lobes; secondary high-contrast white/brown clusters localized at the far lateral distal points (tips) of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex and symmetrical divergent linear boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrations with varying pixel-amplitudes across the entire boundary; highest frequency of peaks and valleys observed on the trailing edges of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curves extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of irregular light pixels localized specifically at the tips of both lobes, representing epibiotic growth or associated scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular textural protrusions at the lateral distal extremities of both fluke lobes.
